one_liner: Corporate spend platform exposing REST APIs for expenses, cards, banking.

evidence.claim: Brex offers a documented public REST API defined with OpenAPI
evidence.quote: Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs.

evidence.claim: Users self-serve API credentials by generating a user token in the Brex dashboard (requires account admin or card admin role)
evidence.quote: Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account admin or card admin

evidence.claim: User tokens are passed as Bearer tokens in the Authorization header
evidence.quote: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.

evidence.claim: Partner OAuth2 (client ID/secret) requires contacting Brex developer support, gating third-party OAuth apps
evidence.quote: Please contact our developer support team to be issued a client ID and client secret for partner authentication.

evidence.claim: Brex officially ships an MCP server documented on its own developer site
evidence.quote: The server is hosted at https://api.brex.com/mcp and supports any MCP-compatible client.

notes: Official MCP server (Beta) supports OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration, so agent clients can connect without partner pre-registration; API key (user token) auth also works for MCP. Caveats: token creation requires an active Brex business account with account/card admin role; user tokens expire after 90 days of inactivity; base URLs transitioned to api.brex.com as of Jan 1, 2026 (old platform.brexapis.com still available); no public sandbox for regular customers (staging is partner-only); MCP lacks approval and card-management actions. Partner OAuth path (needed for multi-customer OAuth apps without BYO token) is gated behind contacting developer support.
